speech.heard: Bhutan generates 99.992% of its electricity from water. Saudi Arabia generates 0%. Bhutan is the world's highest, relying on hydroelectric sources for almost all its power. In South America, Paraguay generates 99.424% of its electricity from water. Major economies rely much less on hydropower. China generates 13.913% while USA generates 5.801%. Top hydro leaders span the globe. Nepal has 98.698%, Ethiopia 97.081% and Norway 89.554%. How does your country generate its power?
